utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—sorry, my memory’s a bit fuzzy. I’m happy to help, just point me to what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren. I’m mostly gathering a few things that need fixing, so I’ll point you to the first one when I’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Rey—just let me know when you’re ready and I’ll do my best to help out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I think I missed the details; what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Just help spread the word and bring any broken items you want fixed. I’ll repeat the plan to everyone once we lock in the time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll spread the word and check around for anything broken I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going — do you need any help?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks for asking, Mina. I’m managing for now, but I may need a hand if the bigger fixes come up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — what kind of bigger fixes are you expecting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve already told a couple folks, and I can keep spreading the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — that’s really helpful. If you hear back on any good drop-off spots, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear of a good drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam — could you help by checking the donated items list and setting aside any tools we still need? I want to make sure we’re only packing what’s actually required.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check the donated items list and set aside any tools we still need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s really kind of you, Leo — could you help sort donated tools and greet people at the table?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can sort the donated tools and greet people at the table.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good, Bo — I can help keep the repair drive organized and on track. What’s the first thing you want to tackle?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — let’s start with sorting the repair list by priority, then we can assign a few people to each job.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll sort the repair list by priority and group the jobs so we can assign people efficiently. If you’ve got any urgent repairs in mind, send them my way first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a little worried about the timing and who’s handling the pickup. Do we know where we’re dropping everything off?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I hear you, Pia. Let’s keep it simple: we’ll confirm the drop-off spot and the pickup person before we move anything.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot. If you send me the address and the pickup contact, I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is happening soon, but I’m still catching up on the details. Have you heard what they need help with?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ve only heard a little so far, but I think they’re looking for volunteers, tools, and maybe some spare parts. I’m planning to stop by and ask for the full list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got left for the repair drive and make a quick list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what we already have before you make the list?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the supplies we already have first, then I’ll make the list.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring a few tools by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Gus — that’d be a big help. I’ll let everyone know you’re coming by with tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet — I’ll swing by with my toolbox and a few extras.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, thanks! I’m still waiting on the final time, but I’ll let you know as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, just send it over when you have it and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line up the repair drive around school pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would be a huge help, Faye — thank you. I’ll share that timing with everyone so we can make it work.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — send me the times, and I’ll work the drive around them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana — is the repair drive still on for Saturday, and do you need any extra hands?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — yes, it’s still on for Saturday. I’ll check the final list first, then I’ll let you know if we need extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Hana. Just let me know if you need me to bring anything or show up early.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on — I heard they’re setting things up as planned.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — I just wanted to make sure it hadn’t been called off.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m putting the repair drive details in order now. What time works best for you to help out?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help in the late afternoon, after 4 works best for me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — after 4 works well. I’ll note you down for the late afternoon and share the final details soon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I have to keep it quiet right now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries — quiet help works. I’ll keep the repair drive low-key and send the details later.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I appreciate you keeping it low-key — send me the details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive happening soon — is that the one you meant?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, yes — that’s the one I meant, I think. I’m a bit forgetful, but it should be the repair drive soon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out for the date and details. If you hear anything else, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what’s the main thing you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think I just need the basic repair stuff... maybe tools and whatever parts people can spare.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll spread the word for tools and spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Sam — I’m in for the repair drive, and I can help with setup or checking in with folks. What do you need most?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’s great, Mara — setup and check-in are exactly what we need most. I really appreciate you pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Happy to help — I can take setup and then check people in as they arrive. Just let me know what time you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away—folks will hear about it from me. Want me to mention anything specific when I do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Quinn—please tell folks we’re looking for volunteers, spare tools, and anyone with repair skills. And if they can, have them bring items needing small fixes to the drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll make sure folks know we need volunteers, spare tools, and repair skills, and I’ll tell them to bring small fixes along too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what do you need me to help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No worries — could you help me keep track of the drop-off spots and where each repair item is going?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I’ll keep track of the drop-off spots and sort out where each item goes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—what’s the current plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure of the latest details yet, but I can check in and let you know. If you’ve heard anything, I’d be glad to compare notes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Rey — I haven’t heard anything new either. Let’s compare notes once you check in.
